images.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: standalone landscape photo of vehicle crash damage
Style/medium: Highly photorealistic natural documentary automotive inspection photograph, realistic physical crash deformation and material behavior, sharp resolved details without a CGI look.
Composition/framing: Landscape close-up. The crash-damaged zone fills 75–90% of the frame, with enough intact vehicle body visible to understand its location. One photograph only, not a collage.
Constraints: No people, no blood, no injuries, no text, no labels, no logos, no visible license plate lettering, no watermark. Realistic unbranded automobile.
Primary request: A black SUV after a collision, rear quarter panel severely buckled above the rear wheel; large compressed folds of black-painted steel and chipped paint exposing gray metal.
Scene/backdrop: An outdoor salvage yard on a cloudy day, background vehicles heavily out of focus.
Composition detail: Rear three-quarter close-up from wheel height, tight on the buckled wheel arch and panel, only a partial rear tire and rear bumper edge visible.
Lighting/mood: Soft overcast daylight, neutral documentary color, detailed subtle reflections on black paint.
